messages:
sara_l: Heads-up: I'm starting a runbook draft for onboarding the new ap-southeast-gpu region. Focus: pulumi modules -> terraform bridge, state backend, cicd gating, quota checks. Need a quick review.

cheng_w: Nice. Can we avoid renaming the shared state bucket? last time the rename caused drift across workspaces.

mike_ops: Suggest per-region state buckets + strong state-locking. GCS with CMEK + object versioning worked well for us. Avoid cross-region replication during bootstrap.

anita_infra: +1 to CMEK. Also put subnet CIDR audit on the checklist — ap-southeast collides with partner VPC ranges in 10.1.0.0/16.

sara_l: Draft excerpt:
```hcl
# pulumi module note -> terraform shim
resource "google_storage_bucket" "state_ap_se_gpu" {
  name     = "redwood-state-ap-se-gpu-${var.env}"
  location = "ASIA-SOUTHEAST1"
  encryption {
    default_kms_key_name = var.cmek_key
  }
}
```
Followed by instructions for `pulumi preview` -> `tf import` steps.

deploy-bot: terraform plan (infra/ap-se-gpu) — completed at 2026-03-18 15:24UTC: Plan: 6 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy.

nate_oncall: FYI quota: GPU quota for A100-V4 is 0 in ap-southeast1. Raised cloud ticket TKT-4589, ETA 48-72h.

julia_se: We should run the validator: `./scripts/region-validate.sh ap-southeast-gpu` — it checks: state bucket reachable, kms key bound, subnet overlap, firewall rules, quota, bootstrap nodes.

cheng_w: Add canary rollout policy: start with 2 nodes, 1 reserved, 1 spot. autoscaler min=2 max=10. Also add a fallback to hosted model routing for first 24h.

anita_infra: Cost check: 4x A100-v4 reserved + networking ~ $24k/mo estimate. We should add a cost review sign-off before provisioning.

sara_l: Updated runbook: CI gating steps -> pulumi preview in PR -> tf import shim in a gated job -> smoke tests (julia_se) -> production apply. Ping @mike_ops for ci job details.

mike_ops: I'll create a guarded pipeline job (pipeline/regional-onboard) that does a `pulumi preview` with limited creds, then a `terraform plan` on a dry run. Will also rotate state bucket IAM to service accounts only.

sara_l: Handoff: @mike_ops owns CI wiring, @cheng_w owns network validation, @julia_se owns smoke tests, @nate_oncall will track quota ticket. I'll be primary for runbook & final sign-off. Let me know when tasks are in Asana.

cheng_w: ack — adding tasks to the "region-onboard" epic. will post checklist items as comments.

anita_infra: sounds good. I'll schedule a cost sync with finance for sign-off.

sara_l: great, thanks everyone. If quota clears earlier I can kick the bootstrap tomorrow morning (UTC) otherwise wait for ticket.
